# qualys_network (Resource)

A Qualys network, allowing the same IP range to exist more than once in a
subscription with its own scanners.

Requires the Network Support feature to be enabled on the subscription.

~> **Destroying this resource does not delete the network.** The Qualys API
provides no delete action for networks — they can only be removed from the
Qualys UI. Terraform will remove the network from state, warn, and leave it in
place.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "qualys_network" "dmz" {
  name = "dmz"
}
```

## Scanner assignment

Appliances are assigned to a network from the appliance side, so `appliance_ids`
is read-only here. Having both ends of the relationship claim ownership would
make the result depend on apply order.

A network with no scanner appliance cannot be scanned.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- **name** (String) Name of the network.

### Optional

- **id** (String) The ID of this resource.

### Read-Only

- **appliance_ids** (List of String) Scanner appliances assigned to this network.

## Import

```shell
terraform import qualys_network.dmz 7343
```
